title: What if every public university disappeared?
narrator: Deadpan documentary: calm and dry, treats the impossible premise like a serious report. The jokes land through understatement.
logline: Every public college vanishes overnight. The private ones are still there, and very busy.

cues.onScreen: What if every public university vanished overnight?
cues.narration: What if every public university vanished overnight?

cues.onScreen: This is every college in America.
cues.narration: Every college in America. One dot each.

cues.onScreen: Most of them are public, like Berkeley and UCLA.
cues.narration: Many are public: Berkeley, UCLA, and your local community college.
cues.delivery: Slight warmth on 'your local community college'.

cues.onScreen: Then one morning, they're just gone.
cues.narration: Then one Tuesday morning, the public ones are just gone.
cues.delivery: No drama; it is just a Tuesday.

cues.onScreen: Poof. Poof. Poof. State by state.
cues.narration: State by state, the map goes dark. Dorm keycards stop working.

cues.onScreen: Only the private colleges are left.
cues.narration: Stanford, Harvard and MIT are still standing. Awkwardly.

cues.onScreen: Problem 1: Most students suddenly have no campus.
cues.narration: Monday: students show up with a backpack and no campus.
Saturday: no stadium. The tailgate happens anyway, out of principle.

cues.onScreen: Problem 3: Every private college's website crashes.
cues.narration: Application day: every private college's website crashes. Before breakfast.

cues.onScreen: So classes move into libraries and coffee shops.
cues.narration: So class moves to libraries, coffee shops, and somebody's garage.

cues.onScreen: Which campus would you miss most?
cues.narration: Which campus would you bring back first?

notes: No numbers are spoken: the public-college count and the share of students at public schools (v03.f.public_count, v03.c.public_share) are empty until the IPEDS release is pinned. Once they are filled in, cue 2 and cue 7 are the places to add them (for example 'Monday: X million students have no campus.').
The caption at 7.5 s says 'Most of them are public'. That depends on v03.c.public_share, so the narration says 'Many' until the number is in.
